envelope.description: Wire the queue in the extension and raise the floor

body.title: Wire the queue in the extension and raise the floor
body.summary: extension.ts: the window key in workspaceState, the repo key from the git top-level's real path (fallbacks), the store under ~/.insrc/chat-queue opened with node:sqlite, isAlive from session-lock's defaultIsAlive and defaultProcessStartTime, the worker given to the chat host, the one-time notice and direct path when the store cannot open; package.json engines.vscode ^1.141.0 and engines.node >=22.13.
acceptanceChecks: Two folders in one git working tree get the same repo key; no folder keys by the process's working directory
The window key survives a reload
When node:sqlite cannot load the chat keeps the direct path and shows the notice once

tests.name: extension wiring: the repo key hashes the real path of the git top-level of the chat folder, the window key is kept in workspaceState, the store opens under ~/.insrc/chat-queue, engines.vscode is ^1.141.0 and engines.node >=22.13, isAlive combines the pid and start-time checks, and when node:sqlite cannot load the chat keeps the direct path and shows the notice once
